description: Peter's wedding and search into his parents' past lead into the Six Forgotten Warriors, Hydro-Man's return, Secret Wars and a multiverse crisis that forces Spider-Man to confront alternate versions of himself.

s05e01.description: Peter and Mary Jane prepare to marry while enemies exploit the ceremony and Peter struggles to believe happiness can survive his double life.

s05e02.description: Peter investigates his parents' past and uncovers a wartime mystery involving forgotten American heroes and a dangerous secret sought by the Kingpin.

s05e03.description: The search for the wartime heroes leads Peter deeper into his family's history while the Kingpin and Red Skull's legacy begin to converge.

s05e04.description: Spider-Man learns how the six wartime heroes gained their powers and why their old mission still matters decades later.

s05e05.description: The surviving warriors reunite as the Red Skull's return turns an old wartime conflict into a new threat.

s05e06.description: Spider-Man and the reunited heroes confront the Red Skull and discover the personal cost behind the secrets Peter has been chasing.

s05e07.description: Hydro-Man reappears and abducts Mary Jane, but strange inconsistencies suggest that neither his return nor hers is what Peter believes.

s05e08.description: Spider-Man uncovers the truth behind Hydro-Man and Mary Jane, forcing Peter to face an artificial reality built around his deepest hopes.

s05e09.description: Madame Web sends Spider-Man to a distant world where the Beyonder asks him to lead a team of heroes against assembled supervillains.

s05e10.description: Spider-Man's alliance battles the Red Skull's forces while competing heroes learn whether they can function under Peter's leadership.

s05e11.description: Doctor Doom seizes the Beyonder's power, leaving Spider-Man's team to confront a ruler who can reshape the world around them.

s05e12.description: Spider-Man is drawn into a reality of alternate Peter Parkers where Spider-Carnage threatens the stability of the multiverse.

s05e13.description: Peter leads his alternate selves against Spider-Carnage in a final struggle that carries him across realities and toward an unexpected meeting.
